description: Optional inspiration palette of design strategies. NOT consulted by runtime routing.

strategies.name: Mobile-first
strategies.description: Design constraints set by smallest viewport; desktop is an enhancement layer.

strategies.name: Accessibility-first
strategies.description: Design constraints set by accessibility requirements (keyboard navigation, screen-reader compatibility, color-contrast); enhancement layers extend rather than override.

strategies.name: Performance-budget-first
strategies.description: Design constraints set by a performance budget (time-to-interactive, bundle size); interactions that exceed the budget are redesigned.

strategies.name: Content-first
strategies.description: Information architecture and layout derive from the actual content shapes, not from container templates filled with placeholders.

strategies.name: Task-completion-first
strategies.description: Optimize for the user's primary task completion rate over secondary metrics (engagement, time-on-site).

strategies.name: Error-recovery-first
strategies.description: Design constraints anchored on the failure modes and recovery paths, not just the happy path.
